name: Rubber Duck
description: Stares at your code. Says nothing. Somehow helps.
flavorOnUse: You explain the bug out loud. You immediately see the bug.

name: "It Works On My Machine" Badge
description: A laminated badge of denial. Deflects blame on contact.
flavorOnUse: You pin the badge on. The jQuery hisses and retreats to a $(document).ready() block.

name: Stack Overflow Bookmark
description: Closed as duplicate. Still the only answer that works.
flavorOnUse: You add one to the loop. Or subtract one. You forget which, again.

name: Hotfix Script
flavorOnUse: You run it in prod. It works. You will never speak of this again.

name: Laptop Charger
description: The good one. The one that doesn't spark.
flavorOnUse: 8% battery becomes 9%. It's enough time to find the backup codes.

name: Signed NDA
description: You can't legally say what this does. Or if it does anything.
flavorOnUse: You reread it. It remains a piece of paper.

name: Tabs vs. Spaces Allegiance
description: A faction, not a tool. You picked a side in 2019 and never looked back.
flavorOnUse: You hold it up like a shield. Nobody is impressed.

name: A README Nobody Wrote
description: Blank except for a single TODO from three years ago.
flavorOnUse: You read it again, hoping new words appeared. They didn't.

name: The One Working Unit Test
description: It passes. Nobody knows why. Nobody dares touch it.
flavorOnUse: You run it for comfort. Green checkmark. All is well, briefly.

name: A Stash You Forgot About
description: git stash list. Three entries. You have no memory of any of them.
flavorOnUse: You pop the stash. It's exactly what you needed. You don't ask why.

name: Screen Recording of the Bug
description: 47 minutes long. Shows the bug happening once, at minute 43.
flavorOnUse: You scrub to minute 43 for the hundredth time. It never gets old.
